summary: Plan created: 5 phases, ~7h. Phase 1 lands the six already-verified theorems in a new FormalSystem/Metalogic/Compactness.lean (three imports: StrongCompleteness, Ultraproduct.Los, Ultraproduct.IndexFilter) and wires it into FormalSystem/Metalogic.lean. Phases 2-4 run in parallel over disjoint territories: Lean docstrings (~23 sites, preserving and reframing the StrongCompleteness.lean:294-308 chronicle-obstruction argument), 7 documentation files, and the paper-side record plus dated author-memo D1/D2 retirement notes. Phase 5 enlarges C14_BASELINE with strongCompletenessBase/strongCompletenessDense and runs the acceptance sweep. Hard constraint carried into Phase 1 and Phase 5: the *_of_compact reductions keep their engine parameters (task 509's work surface); module-invariants-manifest.txt gains no entry.
